results.title: Scheduled jobs
results.why: Scheduled Apex, scheduled reports, and dashboard refreshes do not survive a refresh. Each one is rescheduled by hand or by a post-copy script.
results.action: Record class, schedule, and running user. Reschedule after the refresh.

results.title: Connected apps
results.why: Connected apps copy over, but the tokens users and integrations granted do not. Every integration that authenticates through one re-authorizes against the new sandbox.
results.action: List which integration uses each app and who re-authorizes it.

results.title: Granted OAuth tokens
results.why: Tokens are tied to the org copy they were issued in. After the refresh, every one of these is dead.
results.action: For each app and user, plan the re-authentication and who does it.

results.title: Named credentials
results.why: The definitions copy over. The stored passwords, tokens, and certificates behind them do not.
results.action: Re-enter each credential after the refresh. Know where the secret lives before you start.

results.title: External credentials
results.why: Same as named credentials: the principal secrets have to be re-entered.
results.action: Re-enter principal secrets after the refresh.

results.title: Auth providers and SSO
results.why: Auth providers and SAML configurations copy over, but callback URLs change with the sandbox domain, and identity providers may need the new URLs.
results.action: Update callback URLs on the identity provider side. Test SSO login first thing after the refresh.

results.title: Remote site settings and CSP trusted sites
results.why: These copy over from Production. Any endpoint that exists only for the sandbox (a test API, a staging host) disappears.
results.action: Re-add sandbox-only endpoints after the refresh.

results.title: Certificates
results.why: Certificates copy over, but anything signed for the old sandbox domain or a sandbox-only integration needs checking.
results.action: Confirm each certificate is still valid for its purpose after the refresh.

results.title: Sites and Experience Cloud sites
results.why: Site definitions copy over. Domains, guest user settings, and any sandbox-only site configuration need checking.
results.action: Note each site, its domain, and its guest user profile. Test guest access after the refresh.

results.title: Custom setting data
results.why: Custom setting records are data. A refresh replaces them with Production values. Sandbox-only values (test endpoints, feature switches, kill switches) are lost.
results.action: Export each custom setting now. Re-import the sandbox-only values after the refresh.

results.title: Custom metadata records
results.why: Custom metadata copies over from Production, overwriting any sandbox-only record values.
results.action: Retrieve custom metadata to source control before the refresh so sandbox-only values can be redeployed.

results.title: Users that look like integration or service accounts
results.why: After a refresh every user email gets .invalid appended, passwords are reset, and sessions end. Human users notice. Integration users fail silently at 2 a.m.
results.action: For each one: who owns it, how it authenticates, and who resets it after the refresh.

results.title: Setup changes in the last 90 days
results.why: Configuration done in the sandbox and not yet in source control is overwritten by the refresh. The audit trail shows what changed and who did it.
results.action: Check each change against source control. Retrieve anything missing before the refresh.

results.title: Platform event and change data capture subscribers
results.why: External subscribers hold replay positions for this org copy. After the refresh they reconnect to a new org with new IDs.
results.action: Tell each subscriber owner to reset replay IDs after the refresh.

results.title: Email services
results.why: Email service addresses are regenerated with the new sandbox domain. Anything that sends mail to them points at a dead address.
results.action: Record each address and who sends to it. Update the senders after the refresh.

results.title: Custom object record counts
results.why: A Full or Partial refresh replaces data. Records that exist only in the sandbox (test data, in-progress configuration data) are gone. Developer and Developer Pro sandboxes keep no data at all.
results.action: Export anything you need to keep. Decide per object.

manual: Email deliverability: a refreshed sandbox is set to System email only. Decide whether to raise it, and tell testers.
Email masking: user emails get .invalid appended. Fix the handful that need real mail (integration owners, testers).
Outbound messages, callouts, and webhooks: any endpoint that pointed at the old sandbox URL (My Domain changes) must be updated on the other side.
Login IP ranges and trusted IPs on profiles: confirm they match what the sandbox users need.
Debug logs, trace flags, and Apex test settings: all reset.
Data masking or Data Mask templates: rerun after the refresh if the client requires it.
Installed package license assignments: recheck user assignments after the refresh.
Sandbox post-copy script (an Apex class implementing SandboxPostCopy): the right place to automate everything above that repeats. If there is none, that is a finding too.
